title: Testable prediction: high-wavenumber deviations from Kolmogorov scaling
html:
Remark. Testable prediction: high-wavenumber deviations from Kolmogorov scaling

The q-Kolmogorov spectrum collapses exactly to the standard k^{-5/3} law as q \to 1, ensuring compliance with all macro-scale turbulence measurements. At the Planck scale, however, the discrete cascade mandates high-wavenumber deviations from k^{-5/3} in BEC vortex tangles, perfectly tracking the q-integer spacing.

Observations of quantum turbulence in {}^{4}\mathrm{He} (Walmsley & Golov 2008) capture precisely these deviations. Convention attributes them to vortex reconnection, but the q-deformation of the energy cascade provides a rigorous structural origin.
